paragraphs.en: Headroom compresses everything your AI agent reads — tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files, and conversation history — before it reaches the LLM. Same answers, fraction of the tokens. Compression runs on your machine; no prompt or file content is sent anywhere to be compressed.
paragraphs.zh: Headroom 会在你的 AI 智能体所读取的一切内容到达 LLM 之前进行压缩——包括工具输出、日志、RAG 片段、文件以及对话历史。 同样的答案，只需一小部分 token。 压缩在你的机器上运行；任何提示词或文件内容都不会被发送到别处进行压缩。

paragraphs.en: # 1 — Install uv tool install --python 3.13 " headroom-ai[all] " # CLI in a self-contained env pip install " headroom-ai[all] " # Python — ships the `headroom` CLI npm install headroom-ai # TypeScript SDK only — no CLI # 2 — Pick a mode headroom deploy # turnkey local deployment + agent config headroom wrap claude # wrap a coding agent headroom proxy --port 8787 # drop-in proxy, zero code changes # or: from headroom import compress # inline library # 3 — Check it and watch the savings headroom doctor # health check — confirms routing works headroom perf headroom dashboard # live savings (proxy must be running) Inline, in Python:
paragraphs.zh:
# 1 — 安装

```bash
uv tool install --python 3.13 " headroom-ai[all] "   # 在独立环境中安装 CLI
pip install " headroom-ai[all] "                     # Python — 附带 `headroom` CLI
npm install headroom-ai                              # 仅 TypeScript SDK — 不含 CLI
```

# 2 — 选择一种模式

```bash
headroom deploy          # 开箱即用的本地部署 + 智能体配置
headroom wrap claude     # 包装一个编码智能体
headroom proxy --port 8787   # 即插即用代理，无需更改代码
# 或者：
from headroom import compress   # 内联库
```

# 3 — 检查并查看节省效果

```bash
headroom doctor          # 健康检查 — 确认路由正常工作
headroom perf
headroom dashboard       # 实时节省数据（代理必须正在运行）
```

内联，在 Python 中：

paragraphs.en: from headroom import compress from openai import OpenAI messages = [{ "role" : "user" , "content" : "Analyze these results" }] result = compress ( messages , model = "gpt-4o" ) client = OpenAI () response = client . chat . completions . create ( model = "gpt-4o" , messages = result . messages ) print ( f"Saved { result . tokens_saved } tokens ( { result . compression_ratio :.0% } )" ) Launch a wrapped agent session each time, so the setup runs. headroom wrap starts a local proxy, installs Serena for semantic code navigation, and launches the agent configured to route through Headroom. For Claude Code, Serena is registered for the wrapped project only (as a local -scope MCP server in ~/.claude.json ). Use --code-memory-scope user to make it available in every project, or --code-memory none to skip it. headroom unwrap removes either registration.

paragraphs.en: Everything above shrinks the prompt you send . You also pay for every token the model writes back , and on Opus-class models output costs 5× input. Much of that output is ceremony: "Great, let me…" preambles, code re-printed straight back at you, and deep reasoning spent on routine steps like reading a file.
paragraphs.zh: 以上所有做法都能缩短你发送的提示词。 你还要为模型写回的每个 token 付费，而在 Opus 级模型上，输出成本是输入的 5 倍。 那些输出中有很大一部分是客套内容：比如“好的，让我……”之类的前言、原封不动重新打印给你的代码，以及花费在读文件等常规步骤上的深度推理。

paragraphs.en: export HEADROOM_OUTPUT_SHAPER=1 # off by default headroom proxy --port 8787 Already running a proxy? These switches are read live on every request, so a proxy that headroom wrap reused rather than started would not see a value you export afterwards — its environment was snapshotted at launch. headroom wrap hot-syncs your current settings to the running proxy over a loopback POST /admin/runtime-env , so they take effect with no restart and no dropped requests. On a shared proxy these overrides are global; the last explicit setting wins.
paragraphs.zh: export HEADROOM_OUTPUT_SHAPER=1 # 默认关闭 headroom proxy --port 8787 已经在运行代理了？ 这些开关在每次请求时都会实时读取，因此一个由 headroom wrap 复用而非新启动的代理将看不到你事后 export 的值——它的环境在启动时就被快照了。headroom wrap 会通过环回 POST /admin/runtime-env 将你当前的设置热同步到运行中的代理，因此无需重启、也不会丢失请求即可生效。 在共享代理上，这些覆盖是全局的；最后一个显式设置生效。

paragraphs.en: Headroom can route Copilot CLI subscription traffic through the local proxy:
paragraphs.zh: Headroom 可以通过本地代理路由 Copilot CLI 订阅流量：

paragraphs.en: headroom copilot-auth login headroom wrap copilot --subscription -- --model gpt-4o The wrapper exchanges Headroom's reusable GitHub OAuth token for Copilot's short-lived API token and prints the upstream endpoint as COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_URL=... at launch. headroom copilot-auth login stores a Headroom-specific Copilot OAuth token, rather than relying on generic GitHub or Copilot CLI tokens that can read account metadata but are still rejected by Copilot's token-exchange endpoint.
paragraphs.zh:
headroom copilot-auth login
headroom wrap copilot --subscription -- --model gpt-4o

该包装器将 Headroom 的可复用 GitHub OAuth 令牌换取 Copilot 的短时效 API 令牌，并在启动时以上游端点的形式打印 `COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_URL=...`。`headroom copilot-auth login` 存储的是 Headroom 专用的 Copilot OAuth 令牌，而不是依赖通用的 GitHub 或 Copilot CLI 令牌——这些令牌虽然可以读取账户元数据，但仍会被 Copilot 的令牌交换端点拒绝。

paragraphs.en: For GitHub Enterprise Server or a custom-domain Copilot deployment, set one of these before launching. If both are set, the URL wins:
paragraphs.zh: 对于 GitHub Enterprise Server 或自定义域名的 Copilot 部署，请在启动前设置其中一项。 如果两者都已设置，则以该 URL 为准：

sents.zh: 对于 GitHub Enterprise Server 或自定义域名的 Copilot 部署，请在启动前设置其中一项。

sents.en: If both are set, the URL wins:

paragraphs.en: export GITHUB_COPILOT_ENTERPRISE_DOMAIN=ghe.example.com export GITHUB_COPILOT_ENTERPRISE_URL=https://ghe.example.com For GitHub.com Enterprise Cloud URLs such as github.com/enterprises/your-enterprise , set neither — Headroom uses GitHub's normal token-exchange endpoint and the Copilot API endpoint advertised for the signed-in account.

paragraphs.en: Platform support. macOS auth reuse through Copilot CLI Keychain storage and Windows device authentication are live-tested. Linux Secret Service / secret-tool reuse is implemented but not yet validated on a real desktop. In Docker and CI, pass an explicit GITHUB_COPILOT_TOKEN or GITHUB_COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN instead of relying on host keychain access.
paragraphs.zh: 平台支持。macOS 上通过 Copilot CLI 的 Keychain 存储实现认证复用，Windows 设备认证也已通过实测。 Copilot CLI 1.0.81 不会通过 Headroom 读取的旧版凭据管理器（Credential Manager）模式暴露其 Windows 登录信息，因此在 Windows 上请运行 headroom copilot-auth login。 Linux 的 Secret Service / secret-tool 复用功能已实现，但尚未在真实桌面上验证。 在 Docker 和 CI 环境中，请传入显式的 GITHUB_COPILOT_TOKEN 或 GITHUB_COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN，而不要依赖宿主机的钥匙串访问。

paragraphs.en: Good fit if you run coding agents daily and want savings without touching your code, work across several agents and want one shared memory, or need compression that is reversible — originals stay retrievable through CCR for the configured TTL.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您每天运行编码智能体，希望在不改动代码的情况下节省成本；或者跨多个智能体工作，希望共享同一份记忆；又或者需要可逆的压缩——在配置的 TTL 内，原始内容仍可通过 CCR 检索，那么它很适合您。

paragraphs.en: Skip it if you only use one provider's native compaction and don't need cross-agent memory, or work in a sandbox where local processes can't run.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您只使用单一提供商的原生压缩功能、不需要跨智能体内存，或者所处的沙箱环境无法运行本地进程，则可跳过本节。

paragraphs.en: Headroom pays off on long agent sessions with heavy tool output. Short conversational exchanges, prose, and already-dense payloads see little or no reduction, and blocks under min_input_words come back byte-identical. Limitations has the full list.
paragraphs.zh: 余量在工具输出繁多的长智能体会话中才有回报。 简短的对话交互、散文类文本以及本身已经紧凑的负载几乎没有或没有缩减，且低于 min_input_words 的块会原样返回，逐字节完全相同。 「限制」一节列出了完整清单。

paragraphs.en: One request lifecycle is shared by compress() , the SDKs and the proxy:
paragraphs.zh: 一个请求生命周期由 compress()、SDK 和代理共享：

paragraphs.en: Setup → Pre-Start → Post-Start → Input Received → Input Cached → Input Routed → Input Compressed → Input Remembered → Pre-Send → Post-Send → Response Received
paragraphs.zh: Setup → 启动前 → 启动后 → 收到输入 → 输入已缓存 → 输入已路由 → 输入已压缩 → 输入已记忆 → 发送前 → 发送后 → 收到响应

paragraphs.en: Provider- and tool-specific behaviour lives under headroom/providers/ , so core orchestration stays focused on lifecycle, sequencing and policy:
paragraphs.zh: 特定提供商与工具相关的行为位于 headroom/providers/ 目录下，因此核心编排可以专注于生命周期、时序和策略：

paragraphs.en: uv tool install --python 3.13 " headroom-ai[all] " # CLI, isolated app env pip install " headroom-ai[all] " # Python, everything — includes the CLI npm install headroom-ai # TypeScript SDK (library only) docker pull ghcr.io/headroomlabs-ai/headroom:latest Granular extras: [proxy] , [mcp] , [ml] (Kompress-v2-base), [code] , [memory] , [vector] (optional HNSW backend — needs a C++ toolchain, not in [all] ), [relevance] , [image] , [agno] , [langchain] , [evals] , [pytorch-mps] (Apple-GPU memory-embedder offload — set HEADROOM_EMBEDDER_RUNTIME=pytorch_mps ). Requires Python 3.10+ .
paragraphs.zh:
uv tool install --python 3.13 " headroom-ai[all] " # CLI，隔离的应用环境
pip install " headroom-ai[all] " # Python，全部功能 —— 包含 CLI
npm install headroom-ai # TypeScript SDK（仅库）
docker pull ghcr.io/headroomlabs-ai/headroom:latest

细粒度可选组件： [proxy] 、 [mcp] 、 [ml] （Kompress-v2-base）、 [code] 、 [memory] 、 [vector] （可选的 HNSW 后端 —— 需要 C++ 工具链，不包含在 [all] 中）、 [relevance] 、 [image] 、 [agno] 、 [langchain] 、 [evals] 、 [pytorch-mps] （Apple GPU 内存嵌入器卸载 —— 设置 HEADROOM_EMBEDDER_RUNTIME=pytorch_mps ）。需要 Python 3.10+ 。

paragraphs.en: If pip install "headroom-ai[all]" fails with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED ( unable to get local issuer certificate ), your network runs SSL inspection — a MITM proxy presenting a company CA. The build backend ( maturin ) downloads rustup over a connection your TLS stack does not trust. Install Rust first so the build never fetches it:
paragraphs.zh: 如果 pip install "headroom-ai[all]" 因 CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED（无法获取本地签发者证书）而失败，说明你的网络运行了 SSL 检查——即一个呈现公司 CA 的中间人（MITM）代理。 构建后端（maturin）会通过你的 TLS 栈不信任的连接下载 rustup。 请先安装 Rust，这样构建时就无需再获取它：

sents.en: If pip install "headroom-ai[all]" fails with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED ( unable to get local issuer certificate ), your network runs SSL inspection — a MITM proxy presenting a company CA.
sents.zh: 如果 pip install "headroom-ai[all]" 因 CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED（无法获取本地签发者证书）而失败，说明你的网络运行了 SSL 检查——即一个呈现公司 CA 的中间人（MITM）代理。

sents.en: The build backend ( maturin ) downloads rustup over a connection your TLS stack does not trust.
sents.zh: 构建后端（maturin）会通过你的 TLS 栈不信任的连接下载 rustup。

sents.en: Install Rust first so the build never fetches it:
sents.zh: 请先安装 Rust，这样构建时就无需再获取它：

paragraphs.en: # macOS / Linux curl --proto ' =https ' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh && rustup default stable # Windows winget install Rustlang.Rustup && rustup default stable Restart your shell, then install. A prebuilt wheel avoids the Rust build entirely: pip install --only-binary headroom-ai headroom-ai . Wheels are published for Windows ( win_amd64 ), Linux ( x86_64 / aarch64 ) and macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), so those platforms never need a local Rust toolchain — the Rust-first step above is only for the sdist fallback when no wheel matches.
paragraphs.zh: # macOS / Linux curl --proto ' =https ' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh && rustup default stable # Windows winget install Rustlang.Rustup && rustup default stable 重启你的 shell，然后进行安装。 预构建的 wheel 包可以完全避免 Rust 构建：pip install --only-binary headroom-ai headroom-ai . wheel 包已针对 Windows（ win_amd64 ）、Linux（ x86_64 / aarch64 ）和 macOS（Apple Silicon 与 Intel）发布，因此这些平台无需本地 Rust 工具链——上面的 Rust 优先步骤仅在没有匹配的 wheel 包时用于 sdist 回退方案。

sents.zh: # macOS / Linux curl --proto ' =https ' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh && rustup default stable # Windows winget install Rustlang.Rustup && rustup default stable 重启你的 shell，然后进行安装。

paragraphs.en: At runtime Headroom verifies upstream TLS against the operating system's certificate store — where IT installs the Zscaler / Netskope / Palo Alto root — plus certifi's public roots, so a managed machine normally needs no setup. headroom doctor --network shows who signed each upstream certificate, whether Headroom trusts it, and whether a gateway block page is in the way. If the root is not in the OS store, export it as PEM and set HEADROOM_CA_BUNDLE=/path/to/root.pem ( NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS also works). Full guide and the domain list for IT: Corporate networks .
paragraphs.zh: 运行时 Headroom 会对照操作系统的证书存储（IT 会将 Zscaler / Netskope / Palo Alto 根证书安装于此）以及 certifi 的公共根证书来验证上游 TLS，因此受管机器通常无需任何配置。headroom doctor --network 会显示每个上游证书由谁签署、Headroom 是否信任它，以及是否存在网关拦截页面。 如果根证书不在操作系统证书存储中，可将其导出为 PEM 并设置 HEADROOM_CA_BUNDLE=/path/to/root.pem（NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS 也可以）。 完整指南及提供给 IT 的域名列表请见：企业网络。

paragraphs.en: Running with compression disabled (pure gateway) needs neither asset.
paragraphs.zh: 禁用压缩运行（纯网关）时不需要这两项资源中的任何一个。

paragraphs.en: Intel macOS: no prebuilt ONNX Runtime ( #941 ). ort-sys ships no prebuilt binary for x86_64-apple-darwin , so a source build fails by default even outside a corporate proxy. Point it at a system runtime:
paragraphs.zh: Intel macOS：没有预构建的 ONNX Runtime（ #941 ）。ort-sys 没有为 x86_64-apple-darwin 提供预构建的二进制文件，因此即使在企业代理之外，默认从源码构建也会失败。 将其指向系统运行时：

sents.en: Intel macOS: no prebuilt ONNX Runtime ( #941 ). ort-sys ships no prebuilt binary for x86_64-apple-darwin , so a source build fails by default even outside a corporate proxy.
sents.zh: Intel macOS：没有预构建的 ONNX Runtime（ #941 ）。ort-sys 没有为 x86_64-apple-darwin 提供预构建的二进制文件，因此即使在企业代理之外，默认从源码构建也会失败。

sents.en: Point it at a system runtime:
sents.zh: 将其指向系统运行时：

paragraphs.en: brew install onnxruntime ORT_STRATEGY=system \ ORT_LIB_LOCATION= " $( brew --prefix onnxruntime ) /lib " \ ORT_PREFER_DYNAMIC_LINK=1 \ pip install " headroom-ai[all] " # ORT is dlopen'd at runtime too: export ORT_DYLIB_PATH= " $( brew --prefix onnxruntime ) /lib/libonnxruntime.dylib " ORT_LIB_LOCATION must point at lib/ , not the bare prefix, and ORT_PREFER_DYNAMIC_LINK=1 is required — without it ORT_STRATEGY=system still attempts static linking, which the Homebrew keg does not provide.
paragraphs.zh: brew install onnxruntime ORT_STRATEGY=system \ ORT_LIB_LOCATION= " $( brew --prefix onnxruntime ) /lib " \ ORT_PREFER_DYNAMIC_LINK=1 \ pip install " headroom-ai[all] " # ORT 在运行时也是通过 dlopen 加载的： export ORT_DYLIB_PATH= " $( brew --prefix onnxruntime ) /lib/libonnxruntime.dylib " ORT_LIB_LOCATION 必须指向 lib/ 目录，而不是裸的前缀路径，并且必须设置 ORT_PREFER_DYNAMIC_LINK=1 —— 否则 ORT_STRATEGY=system 仍会尝试静态链接，而 Homebrew keg 并不提供静态链接。

paragraphs.en: "Basic Constraints of CA cert not marked critical" only occurs with HEADROOM_CERT_STORE=bundled (the OS store verifies these roots fine). If TLS fails with:
paragraphs.zh: "CA 证书的基本约束（Basic Constraints）未标记为关键" 仅在使用 HEADROOM_CERT_STORE=bundled 时出现（操作系统信任库可以正常验证这些根证书）。如果 TLS 失败并出现：

paragraphs.en: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: Basic Constraints of CA cert not marked critical then the corporate CA is found and trusted, and adding it to a CA bundle changes nothing. Python 3.13 with OpenSSL 3.x enables VERIFY_X509_STRICT by default, which enforces RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9: a CA cert's basicConstraints must be marked critical. Inspection roots such as Zscaler set CA:TRUE without the critical bit, so the chain is rejected.
paragraphs.zh: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] 证书验证失败：CA 证书的基本约束（Basic Constraints）未标记为关键（critical），而此时企业 CA 已被发现并受信任，将其添加到 CA 捆绑包中也不会有任何改变。 Python 3.13 配合 OpenSSL 3.x 默认启用了 VERIFY_X509_STRICT，该选项强制执行 RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9：CA 证书的 basicConstraints 必须标记为关键（critical）。 Zscaler 等检查类根证书将 CA 设置为 TRUE 但未设置关键（critical）位，因此证书链会被拒绝。

sents.en: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: Basic Constraints of CA cert not marked critical then the corporate CA is found and trusted, and adding it to a CA bundle changes nothing.
sents.zh: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] 证书验证失败：CA 证书的基本约束（Basic Constraints）未标记为关键（critical），而此时企业 CA 已被发现并受信任，将其添加到 CA 捆绑包中也不会有任何改变。

sents.en: Python 3.13 with OpenSSL 3.x enables VERIFY_X509_STRICT by default, which enforces RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9: a CA cert's basicConstraints must be marked critical.
sents.zh: Python 3.13 配合 OpenSSL 3.x 默认启用了 VERIFY_X509_STRICT，该选项强制执行 RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9：CA 证书的 basicConstraints 必须标记为关键（critical）。

sents.en: Inspection roots such as Zscaler set CA:TRUE without the critical bit, so the chain is rejected.
sents.zh: Zscaler 等检查类根证书将 CA 设置为 TRUE 但未设置关键（critical）位，因此证书链会被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: An anonymous beacon is on by default . It reports how compression behaved: ratios, counters, provider and model IDs, OS and architecture. It never sends prompts, completions, code or file paths. It exists so we can see when a release regresses a compression ratio across real workloads rather than only our own test corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 匿名信标默认开启。 它报告压缩的表现情况：压缩比、计数器、提供方和模型 ID、操作系统和架构。 它绝不会发送提示词、补全内容、代码或文件路径。 它的存在是为了让我们能够发现某次发布是否在真实工作负载中降低了压缩比，而不仅仅是在我们自己的测试语料库中。

paragraphs.en: Headroom is the proxy, and it compresses everything flowing through it whatever sits upstream. Our recommended companion is Serena for semantic code navigation, installed by default when you wrap an agent, plus Ponytail if you want leaner model output. Everything else is your call — attach a code-memory MCP, Graphify, Caveman, or any other MCP server, and Headroom compresses downstream of all of it.
paragraphs.zh: Headroom 是一个代理层，它会压缩流经其中的一切内容，无论上游是什么。 我们推荐搭配使用 Serena 来进行语义化代码导航——当你包装智能体时它会默认安装；如果你想要更精简的模型输出，还可以加上 Ponytail。 其他一切由你决定——你可以挂载 code-memory MCP、Graphify、Caveman 或任何其他 MCP 服务器，Headroom 会在所有这些之后进行下游压缩。

paragraphs.en: headroom wrap routes OpenAI-compatible traffic to the default upstream ( https://api.openai.com/v1 ). For a third-party OpenAI-compatible provider (DeepSeek, Together, OpenRouter, a self-hosted gateway), pass --openai-api-url https://api.deepseek.com/v1 — or set OPENAI_TARGET_API_URL before wrapping — otherwise your provider key is sent to OpenAI and rejected with 401 Incorrect API key provided . See OpenCode + DeepSeek . ↩
paragraphs.zh: headroom wrap 将兼容 OpenAI 的流量路由到默认上游 ( https://api.openai.com/v1 )。 对于第三方兼容 OpenAI 的提供商（DeepSeek、Together、OpenRouter、自托管网关），请传入 --openai-api-url https://api.deepseek.com/v1 —— 或在运行 wrap 之前设置 OPENAI_TARGET_API_URL —— 否则你的提供商密钥会被发送到 OpenAI，并被拒绝，报错 401 Incorrect API key provided 。 参见 OpenCode + DeepSeek 。↩
